request: Implement generate(files,output_archive) in src/manifest.py and wire src/cli.py run(payload). files maps safe relative file paths to UTF-8 text of regular files. Exclude output_archive and names ending .tmp, sort paths ascending, SHA-256 the UTF-8 content. Return {"manifest":[{"path":path,"sha256":hex}]}. Document verifying SHA-256; no filesystem walk is requested. Documentation must contain these literal phrases: ["SHA-256", "manifest"]. Preserve all public interfaces stated here. Python entrypoint is src.cli.run(payload). Inputs are JSON objects; return only plain JSON-compatible values (no Decimal objects, sets or tuples). Use only the standard library. Visible test tools check syntax only; functional verification is external.
title: Generate a reproducible archive manifest
